questions.learningObjective: Assess association with an outlier present.
questions.stem: A manifold design brief shows a scatterplot with a downward trend and one low outlier.

options.text: Overall association is negative despite the low outlier.
The low outlier makes association positive.
There is no association because points scatter.
The outlier must be deleted before analysis.

questions.explanation: The overall downward trend indicates negative association, even with one low outlier.
questions.hint: Judge the overall trend, not one point.

questions.stem: A linkage design brief asks what a residual plot reveals about model fit.

answer.exemplar: It shows whether residuals are randomly scattered, revealing nonlinearity, outliers, or nonconstant variance that the summary r hides.
